title: What If You Were Born Without Fingerprints? A Few Are

scenes.text: What if you had no fingerprints at all? A few families on Earth don't.
The condition is called adermatoglyphia. A mutation in one gene, SMARCAD1, stops skin ridges forming.
In 2007, a Swiss woman had trouble entering the United States, because she had no fingerprints.
Doctors traced eight printless relatives, then found three unrelated families. Four families in total.
It's dominant, so one altered copy of the gene is enough, and often one parent has it.
Otherwise they're healthy, apart from slightly fewer sweat glands. Its nickname: the immigration delay disease.

description:
What if you were born without fingerprints?
A mutation in the SMARCAD1 gene stops the ridges forming, and only a few families worldwide are known to have it.
